answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can publish a market signal. The stake is slashed if peers prove the signal was fake or duplicated, so creating many fake identities multiplies the attacker's locked cost instead of multiplying influence. Each identity must also send a regular pulse — signed proof it still controls its staked key — or its standing lapses, like a lone raven losing its place in the flock when it stops calling.
